rationale: S-0033-02 proposes instantiating AIS_PROXIMAL / AIS_DISTAL / THIN_AXON channel sets on t0022 as a t0033 optimiser prerequisite. The t0033 optimiser plan remains deferred until a working from-scratch substrate is in hand (per brainstorm 9 and brainstorm 10), and the substrate choice has shifted from t0022 to the from-scratch family. The channel-set instantiation should be re-formulated against the from-scratch substrate. Reprioritising from high to medium.
